name: aurum-four
description: Aurum Four is a luxury two-player, same-device Connect Four built to demo live to clients. Gold-on-aubergine design, spring-physics discs, confetti wins, undo and rematch, light/dark themes, sound, keyboard play. React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Zustand. No backend or database.

paragraphs: Aurum Four is a two-player, same-device Connect Four built to be demoed live to a client. The board is a lacquered aubergine-black slab with a gold-leaf edge. Discs drop with spring physics, and every win ends in a confetti burst and a rematch prompt.
It runs entirely in the browser. There is no backend and no database. Only scores, names, theme and mute state are saved, in localStorage.
features: Two players on one screen, 7×6 board, first to four in a row wins
Spring-physics disc drops with a ghost preview of where your disc will land
Glowing winning line, confetti burst and a result dialog with a rematch prompt
Session scoreboard with animated score changes and a reset button
Undo last move, restart round, rematch (swaps who starts) and back to menu
